ios.desc:
A peaceful garden where you meet tiny, adorable friends.

From time to time, animals and little creatures wander into your garden.
Relax and watch, place items, and slowly grow a garden that feels like your own.

Collect coins to unlock stones, grass, lights, and other items,
and gently shape the atmosphere of your space.
Move things around, decorate with the seasons,
and create a garden that matches your mood.

Your garden changes slowly with the seasons and the weather.
On sunny days, it glows with soft light.
On rainy days, it becomes calm and quiet.
As time passes, the scenery evolves little by little.

Connected with hanaco Weather,
your garden is also linked to the sky beyond.
Tiny weather posts and gentle messages from around the world
can softly drift into your peaceful space.

The visitors are wonderfully unpredictable.
They appear out of nowhere, stay for a while, and wander off again.
Each time you open the app, a small new moment awaits.

There are no complicated controls or time pressure.
Even a few seconds is enough.
Perfect for a quick break during your commute
or a quiet moment before bed.

This isn’t a game about competition or completion.
It’s a gentle space to enjoy building a small garden at your own pace.
A place that helps you unwind, little by little, every time you visit.

In the middle of busy days,
take a small breath here.
A soft, peaceful garden that quietly stays by your side.

quotes.text:
A small side project I've been working on.

hanaco Garden is a calm iOS garden where small creatures appear over time and move around the space.

Recently added OS Yamato account backup so gardens can be restored across devices.

Would love feedback.
